subject: Pen test package request ahead of PO signature — MAP gating
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwaterhealth.com>, Legal <legal@clearwaterhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Pen test + remediation evidence for PO / MAP gating

Hi Alex,

We're finalizing the SOW/PO for the MAP-2294 engagement and procurement has requested our vendor security evidence before they will clear the signature. Can you share the latest penetration test deliverables and a high-level remediation status? Specifically they asked for:

- A redacted penetration test report suitable for procurement/legal review (no active exploit PoC or tester contact details)
- A remediation tracker or ETA for any critical/high findings that are not yet closed in prod
- Confirmation of SOC 2 status and the date of the latest report

Our timeline is tight: we need the materials in our procurement portal by EOD 2026-02-25 to hit our internal MAP gating window. If there are issues sharing the full report, what minimal evidence will satisfy procurement (attestation letter, redacted summary + tracker, live demo)?

Thanks,
Maya Singh\Head of Procurement\Clearwater Health

Attachments: PO_template.docx (sent by procurement team)

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test + remediation evidence for PO / MAP gating

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up and the timeline. We can support the MAP gating request; below is what we can deliver and the usual controls we apply to sensitive material:

What we can provide by 2026-02-24:
- Redacted penetration test summary (PDF) suitable for procurement/legal review. Redactions remove PoC exploit code, live tester IPs, and any internal creds; methodology and findings remain intact.
- Remediation tracker spreadsheet with current status, responsible owners, and planned production rollout dates.
- SOC 2 Type II attestation PDF (latest: 2025-11-02).

If procurement requires more than a redacted report, we can provide an auditor attestation letter and a scoped executive summary. We do not share raw PoC steps or tester contact info. For particularly sensitive customers we offer a secure NDA review process and an on-call walkthrough with our security engineer.

I've attached our redaction policy and will circulate the tracker once Neha gives the final status items. Can you confirm whether procurement is okay with a redacted report + tracker + SOC2 attestation? If they insist on an unredacted report to run their own tests, we'll need a personnel and access plan (and likely an NDA).

Regards,
Alex Martinez\Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_pt_redaction_policy.txt

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@clearwaterhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test + remediation evidence for PO / MAP gating

Alex/Monica — adding the security perspective and a quick status snapshot so procurement has clarity.

Scope covered by our latest pen test (Dec 2025):
- External network perimeter and public load balancers
- Public API endpoints (inference API, auth endpoints)
- Customer-facing console (SaaS portal) at the authentication and session levels

Current high/critical items and remediation status:
- CVE-2025-4421 (JWT key exposure in staging): mitigated in staging 2026-02-01; scheduled for prod deploy 2026-02-24 (post smoke tests)
- CRITICAL: Rate-limiting bypass on legacy token endpoint: fix shipped to staging 2026-02-10; verification scheduled; prod deployment planned 2026-02-26
- MEDIUM: HTTP header misconfiguration — fixed rolling config 2026-01-15

Minimum acceptable evidence for procurement/legal (recommended):
1) Redacted pen test summary PDF (findings + severity + remediation plan)
2) Remediation tracker CSV/XLSX showing target production dates and owners
3) SOC 2 Type II attestation PDF

If they request additional assurance we can supply:
- An auditor attestation letter describing redaction approach
- A secure remote walkthrough (screen-share) with our security engineer to answer technical questions

I'll export the remediation tracker and the snapshot of outstanding items and update the production ETA after the 02/24 deploy.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor\Head of Security & Compliance\Redwood Inference

Attachments: remediation_state_snapshot_20260219.csv

- Redacted pen test summary PDF (no PoC or tester contacts)

We can also take an auditor attestation letter if easier than sharing more detail. Please upload the materials into our procurement portal (link below) and confirm once done so we can clear the PO in time for the MAP window.

Procurement portal: https://procure.clearwaterhealth.com/upload/MAP-2294

We appreciate the quick turnaround — we need these in by EOD 2026-02-25 to avoid an extra approval cycle.

Regards,
Maya Singh\Head of Procurement\Clearwater Health
